translations.web: The children of Merari according to their families had twelve cities out of the tribe of Reuben, out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.
translations.bsb: And the descendants of Merari received twelve cities from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
translations.kjv: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
